leave_sick_days_001.answer: 12 days (10-month teachers), 13.5 days (11-month teachers), 15 days (12-month teachers)
leave_sick_days_001.evidence: Twelve (12) days (96 hours) of sick leave are posted at the beginning of each school year for ten (10) month teachers. / Fifteen days (15) days (120 hours) of sick leave are posted at the beginning of each school year for twelve (12) month Teachers / Thirteen and one half (13.5) days (108 hours) of sick leave are posted at the beginning of each school year for eleven (11) month teachers

leave_sick_accrual_002.answer: Unused sick leave carries forward year-to-year; general leave is not cumulative. No maximum accumulation cap is stated.
leave_sick_accrual_002.evidence: Unused sick leave shall be carried forward from year to year. / General leave shall not be cumulative. / All unused and unreturned sick leave shall be carried forward from year to year.
